rationale: T138 adds an optional search parameter to GET /inventory/balances so matching occurs before the existing 100-row limit. Existing clients without search receive unchanged response shapes and authorization scope.
migration: Deploy the API before the updated frontend. No database migration or API version change is needed. Roll back the frontend first if necessary; clients omitting search remain supported.
validation: Regression checks prove a match beyond the first 100 rows is found, absent matches return no rows, malformed queries are rejected, and Driver scope remains enforced. Generated OpenAPI/types and runtime contract validation are included. This note documents the change for ordinary maintainer review; it is not a claim of human approval.
